title: eBay UK announces Simple Delivery rollout for private sellers
summary: In a documented announcement published 4 April 2025, eBay UK said Simple Delivery would be the only delivery method for private sellers listing most items starting 15 April 2025.
body_markdown: Eligible existing listings were scheduled to transition from 7 April through the end of April 2025. These are announced rollout dates, not proof that every eligible seller or listing was switched on one day.
affected_sellers: UK private sellers on eBay.co.uk listing eligible items; not business sellers
source_title: eBay UK staff announcement — Updates on Simple Delivery

evidence_details.scope: eBay.co.uk UK private sellers listing eligible items; not business sellers or all categories
conditions: 15 April 2025 is the announced start for new listings, not verified universal enforcement.
Eligible existing listings were scheduled to transition from 7 April through the end of April 2025; completion is not independently established.
The April announcement excludes custom-delivery items exceeding 61 × 46 × 46 cm or 20 kg, Authenticity Guarantee items, and items exceeding £750 (listed-price thresholds excluding shipping).

Some letter-sized categories weighing up to 100 grams and priced at a maximum of £10 excluding buyer fees could still use untracked services. These are historical announcement conditions, not a claim about current limits.
evidence_details.impact: For in-scope listings, sellers would use an eBay-provided QR code/prepaid printable label instead of purchasing their own label. No measured operational disruption or quantified economic impact is asserted.
